topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The opening framing introduces the lecture and outlines the learning objectives on cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional cancer treatment modalities, including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy, alongside their associated toxicities and efflux-mediated drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting cellular vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer cell alterations, including hormone dependency, cell cycle checkpoint deficiencies, and defective DNA repair via synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Kinase oncogene addiction and kinase inhibitor resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the molecular mechanisms, such as gatekeeper mutations and bypass signaling, that lead to kinase inhibitor resistance.

topics.label: Antibody-based targeted therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the design and therapeutic application of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor surface antigens.

topics.label: Immune surveillance and immune checkpoint blockade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the evidence for natural anti-tumor immunity and the reactivation of exhausted T cells using immune checkpoint inhibitors targeting tumor neoantigens.

topics.label: Engineered T-cell therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe synthetic immunotherapy strategies designed to engage and redirect cytotoxic T cells using bispecific T-cell engagers and chimeric antigen receptors.

topics.label: Overarching challenges, future paradigms, and clinical progress in cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review the systemic challenges, historical survival trends, emerging management paradigms, and clinical dilemmas in treating cancer.
